messages:
maria_gupta: Hey team — PRD draft for org+project scoped access (API keys, scoped tokens, RBAC). Putting the draft here for quick review. TL;DR: support org-owned API keys, project-level scoped tokens, service accounts, rotation and audit trail. Need: launch criteria, acceptance tests, and edge-case handling. Draft: https://redwood.internal/prd/org-project-access (wip)

alex_chen: reading now. quick q: do we allow multi-project tokens (one token that can access several projects)?

maria_gupta: prefer 'no' for initial launch — keep token -> single project or org. Multi-project is complex for billing/audit. we can add as future enhancement. will note rationale in PRD.

danielle_roberts: edge case: project deletion while tokens are active. PRD says revoke tokens on delete, but need clarity on propagation and user notification. acceptance criteria?

maria_gupta: good catch. proposed acceptance: revocation propagated to runtime + rejected for new requests within 60s and audit log entry created. is 60s conservative enough?

samir_khan: 60s is realistic. runtime KV caches could serve inflight up to ~45s. we can attempt immediate cache invalidation on delete; fallback: mark token as "stale" and deny. include retry/reconciliation job.

priya_singh: also consider org-wide compromise scenario: bulk rotate + block old keys. UX: provide a minted "rotation" admin token so ops can rotate without downtime. include migration path and SDK helpers.

alex_chen: acceptance tests idea: unit + e2e: create org, create key, call /v1/generate with key, revoke key, subsequent call -> 401. add a race test: delete project while request inflight (expect either success or 401 but no silent auth bypass).

maria_gupta: agree. add performance targets: auth check should add <2ms p50 and <10ms p99. tag telemetry: token_type, scope, owner_id. update PRD with test matrix.

danielle_roberts: edge: service accounts on Dedicated/Private where KMS/HSM constraints exist. some customers require HSM-bound keys and offline rotation. add optional flag `hsm_bound` and a separate lifecycle with docs.

samir_khan: :thumbsup: rollout plan proposal: feature-flagged beta with 3 pilot customers on Dedicated, then staged rollout to hosted via canary regions. need metric gates: auth error rate, latency regression, token revocation time.

sec-bot: automated reminder: include SOC2/ISO controls: documented key rotation cadence, audit trail retention, least-privilege defaults, and role separation. checklist: https://internal.redwood/sec-checks

priya_singh: draft launch checklist (proposal): 1) PRD merged + RFC reviewed, 2) design + security sign-off, 3) e2e tests & perf targets met, 4) 2 customer pilots + pilot feedback, 5) SDK + docs updated, 6) migration + rotation tooling, 7) rollout plan with feature flags, 8) incident runbook + rollback plan.

maria_gupta: thanks — I'll update the PRD and call out owners. can folks ack the items they own? @alex_chen runtime perf, @samir_khan rollout/canary, @priya_singh migration/docs.

alex_chen: +1

samir_khan: +1

priya_singh: +1

maria_gupta: great. I'll post an updated PRD link and ping eng-platform + ops when it's ready. leaving this thread open for any final UX/security edge cases. :eyes:
